notes.title: Update Notes for 07/12/2024
Update Notes for 10/11/2042
notes.notes:
The end of the Halloween event.
 Bots relaxed a little bit.
 Blackout during second phase of Boss Exterminator has been reduced, now it will be lighter in general.
 Minor fixes.

Thank you all for your feedback, you are helping to make the game better!

notes.title: Update Notes for 28/10/2024
notes.notes: The game is getting faster. And harder.

notes.title: BOO!! Cyber Soldier is here! Halloween release on Steam.
notes.notes:
Hello guys!,

The day has come when Cyber Soldier finally saw the light of day, and it so happened.. that it saw the light not of a day but of a full moon, with gloomy mist all around, the dead [strike]air[/strike], and undead creatures wandering everywhere from the beyond... Evil laughter echoes through the oppressive atmosphere, as evil celebrates its [strike]freedom.[/strike]

And this is your time, Cyber, gear up with powerful weapons and start destroying everything around!
Open fire on all threats immediately.

After all, someone has to cleanse all the evil, right?
